description: FTI200_LIL-Lille is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by flibco.com. This dataset contains scheduled shuttle bus tours operating between Lille City Center (Flandre station) and Lille Airport (LIL). Each entry includes the bus tour ID, departure date and time, stop information. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 2 resources in JSON. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
